name: 95821 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95821 (Sacramento) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95821 (Sacramento) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95821 (Sacramento) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 59 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
